title: 3DO DevBench — Screen & input
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: Status pills
items.text: Run mode (running / paused), guest frame counter and CPU state (running, or HALTED in red at a breakpoint).

items.label: Run controls
items.text: Run (real time), Turbo, Pause, +1 frame / +60, CPU halt (debugger freeze), Reset and Reboot for the selected session.

items.label: Live display
items.text: The emulator framebuffer, refreshed several times a second while running (1×–3×); clicking it fires a light gun on that port.

items.label: Scale & live
items.text: Display scale and live refresh toggle.

items.label: Control pad
items.text: Hold D-pad and A/B/C/L/R/P/X with the mouse; buttons stay down while pressed (MCP: emu_press / emu_input).

items.label: Keyboard control
items.text: Arrows = D-pad, Z/X/C = A/B/C, Enter = P, Backspace = X, Q/W = L/R.

items.label: Peripherals
items.text: Per-port device: joypad, flightstick, mouse, light guns, Orbatak trackball or none.

items.label: Capture
items.text: Save a screenshot or an animated GIF of the next N frames (MCP: emu_look / emu_record_gif).
